products.name: Pasteurized Standardized Milk
products.tagline: Shuddhata ka Vaada, Sehat ka Iraada
products.taglineEnglish: A promise of purity, a commitment to health
products.shortDescription: Everyday fresh, full-cream flavour milk sourced from healthy cows and pasteurised for your family's safety.
description: Maa Saraswati Pasteurized Standardized Milk is the milk our own families drink every morning. It arrives from grass-fed, healthy cows, is standardised to a consistent 4.5% fat, and is pasteurised to remove harmful bacteria without spoiling the natural taste.

No preservatives, no synthetic colour, no adulterants — just clean, warm, full-cream milk that tastes the way milk should. Rich in calcium, protein and energy, it is the everyday foundation for tea, coffee, porridge, sweets and a growing child.
Each 500 ml pouch is sealed at the dairy and reaches your shelf the same day, so the milk in your kitchen is always fresh, never re-boiled and never stretched.

features.text: Collected from healthy, grass-fed cows. Nothing added, nothing taken away.

features.text: A balanced source of calcium, protein and clean energy for every age.

faqs.a: Yes. The fat content is standardised to 4.5%, which gives it a rich, full-cream taste and a creamy layer you can see on top after boiling.
Standardisation adjusts the fat level of every batch to a fixed 4.5%. That means the taste and richness stay the same carton to carton, unlike unstandardised milk.
The milk is briefly heated to a controlled temperature to kill harmful bacteria, then rapidly cooled. It is why our milk keeps longer and is safer for children and older family members.

products.name: High Protein Paneer
products.taglineEnglish: Strength and freshness in every bite
products.shortDescription: Soft, fresh, high-protein paneer made from pure milk — soft enough to melt in the mouth, firm enough for a clean cube.
description: Maa Saraswati Paneer is made from pure, fresh milk and nothing else. Slow-set in warm milk, then cut into soft, snow-white cubes that are firm enough to hold their shape and delicate enough to melt straight into a curry.

Every 200 g pack is a high-protein favourite for the whole family. It is 100% vegetarian, contains no artificial colours, flavours or preservatives, and is packed the same day it is set so the texture stays soft and the taste stays clean.
Whether it is in a hot sarson da saag, a layered shrikhand, a grilled tikka or everyday sabzi, this is the paneer that makes a simple meal feel festive.

features.title: High in Protein
features.text: Rich in milk proteins that support muscle growth, repair and recovery.

features.title: Builds Immunity

faqs.a: Yes. It is 100% vegetarian, sealed with the green dot symbol, and contains no artificial colours, flavours or preservatives.
We set fresh milk with a natural coagulant, then drain and cut it into cubes. No vegetable fat, no starch, no fillers.

faqs.q: Why does my paneer not crumble when frying?
faqs.a: Our paneer has a high protein content, which gives it a firm, springy texture. Dry the cubes lightly on a towel and shallow-fry in medium heat for the best golden edges.

faqs.q: How long does it stay good?
faqs.a: Check the packed-on and use-before date on the pack. Once opened, keep refrigerated and use within 2 days.

faqs.q: Can I use it for sweets?
faqs.a: Absolutely. It is the standard choice for shrikhand, kheer and rasmalai because the high protein keeps the texture smooth after chilling.

products.name: Thick Set Fresh Curd
products.tagline: Garmiyon ka asli doodh, garm nahi
products.taglineEnglish: Set with cold milk, never reheated
products.shortDescription: Thick, creamy curd set from cold pasteurized milk — spoonable, never reheated, and ready in 4 hours.
description: Good curd starts with good milk. We set Maa Saraswati curd from cold pasteurized milk and a live culture, so the milk is never reheated after boiling — which is exactly why it stays thick, creamy and full of flavour.

The result is curd that holds its shape on the spoon, with a clean tang and no added starch, colour or thickener. Add a pinch of sugar for a simple dessert, or take it straight to the table with pickle and onion.

features.title: Never Reheated
features.text: Set from cold milk after boiling, so the taste stays clean and fresh.

features.title: Thick & Creamy
features.text: Holds its shape on the spoon with a naturally light tang.

features.title: Hygienic Process
features.text: Packed in sealed food-grade tubs with no starch or colour added.

features.title: Everyday Fresh
features.text: Made in small batches daily and delivered within 24 hours of setting.

faqs.q: Why is my home-made curd runny?
faqs.a: Most often the milk was set while still warm, or it was reheated later. Our curd is set from cold milk and never reheated, so it stays thick.
Yes. A soft, easily digested source of calcium and protein. Serve plain or with fruit for kids.

faqs.q: Is any starch or thickener added?
faqs.a: No. Maa Saraswati curd is made from milk and live cultures only.

products.name: Cultured Salted Butter
products.tagline: Malai ki khushbu, ghar jaisa swaad
products.taglineEnglish: The aroma of malai, the taste of home
products.shortDescription: Slow-churned from cream with live cultures, for a rich malai flavour that melts clean on hot parathas.
description: We churn our butter slowly from fresh cream, using a live culture the way it has always been done in an Indian kitchen. That slow churn is what gives Maa Saraswati Butter its clean, malai-like aroma instead of a waxy, industrial smell.
Lightly salted for everyday cooking, it melts into a golden layer on a hot paratha, browns bread properly, and makes a simple dal taste like a restaurant dish.

products.name: Pure Bilona Desi Ghee
products.shortDescription: Hand-churned from cultured white butter, in small batches, until the grain turns golden and the aroma is unmistakable.
description: Good ghee announces itself before you taste it. Ours is made by hand-churning fermented curd in small batches, never in a large steel drum, and stopped the moment the grains turn golden and the kitchen smells of warm nuts.

The result is grainy, golden ghee that melts into a warm roti, makes dal tadka taste festive, and turns a simple halwa into something your family will remember. No blending, no vegetable oil, no shortcuts.

features.title: Traditional Bilona Method
features.text: Hand-churned from cultured curd, the way ghee has always been made at home.

features.title: Rich in Fatty Acids
features.text: Naturally contains healthy fats and fat-soluble vitamins.

features.title: Grainy & Golden

faqs.a: Bilona means made from bilona curd, not cream. The curd is hand-churned into butter, then that butter is churned again into ghee. It takes longer and costs more, and that is the entire point.

faqs.q: How is it different from vanaspati?
faqs.a: Vanaspati is hydrogenated vegetable oil. Our ghee is pure animal milk fat, with a grainy texture and a real aroma.

faqs.q: Why is the jar not completely full?
faqs.a: Ghee can separate slightly in transit because it is a natural product. A small air gap prevents the jar from cracking and is completely normal.

products.name: Sliced Cheddar Cheese
products.tagline: Kacche burgers ke asli taste ke liye
products.shortDescription: Aged cheddar that melts into a proper cheese pull on a burger and turns a plain dosa into a great one.
description: A real cheddar has to do one thing well: melt. Ours is aged, then milled fine so it melts evenly into a smooth, stretchy layer without splitting or going oily.
Slice it thin for burgers and sandwiches, grate it over dosas and uttapams, or fold it into a macaroni bake. Vegetarian, with a clean snap and a balanced, slightly sharp cheddar note.

faqs.q: Why doesn't my cheese slice melt smoothly?
faqs.a: Let the slice sit at room temperature for 5 minutes before cooking, and use medium-low heat. High heat makes cheese split and release oil.

products.name: Fresh Cooking Cream
products.taglineEnglish: For gravies, as you need it
products.shortDescription: Heavy fresh cream at 25% fat, single-cream consistency that thickens any gravy without splitting.
description: Cream that splits is the most common complaint in an Indian kitchen, and it is almost always because the cream was not fresh or the heat was too high. Ours is 25% fat, made fresh daily from our own milk, with a clean taste and no added thickener.
Add it at the end of a gravy over low heat and stir for a minute. It will not split, and it will thicken the sauce into something glossy and restaurant-smooth.

faqs.q: How do I stop cream from splitting?
faqs.a: Reduce the gravy first, then add the cream over low heat and stir continuously for under two minutes. Boiling cream is what causes splitting.
You can, but the texture separates on thawing. It is best used fresh, within 2 days of opening, kept refrigerated.
